comments.content: The test checks for 'deepseek-flash', which is no longer part of the returned models. Update the test to check for 'deepseek-chat' instead.
Missing test cases for resolveAmbientPreset; suggest adding table-driven tests.

summary.walkthrough: This PR introduces a deduplication feature for comments emitted by the LLM, ensuring that duplicate comments at the same location are collapsed into one. Additionally, it refines the filtering of scanner findings to exclude irrelevant paths, enhancing the accuracy of the emitted results.

change_groups.title: Comment Deduplication and Scanner Findings Filtering
change_groups.summary: The changes in this group implement a deduplication function for comments that share the same location, ensuring that only the first comment is retained. It also adds a filtering mechanism to scanner findings, which excludes findings from paths that are not part of the current PR, such as those in .claude/ and vendor directories. This improves the relevance of the emitted comments and findings.

change_groups.title: LLM Provider Updates
change_groups.summary: This group updates the LLM provider configuration to use the current DeepSeek model names and adjusts tests accordingly. It also enhances the resolver logic to support ambient authentication for providers that do not require an API key, ensuring that the system can handle various authentication scenarios more flexibly.

summary.testing_notes: Reviewers should run the tests in 'cmd/zreview/emit_test.go' and 'cmd/zreview/scanners_test.go' to verify the deduplication and filtering functionalities. Additionally, check the LLM provider tests in 'internal/llm/providers_test.go' and 'internal/llm/tiers_test.go' to ensure the new model configurations are correctly implemented.
summary.risk: medium: The changes involve significant logic alterations in comment handling and filtering, which could affect the output if not thoroughly tested.
